060e3314734e8774569db473b0b7bcde28a110e4.summary: Cado Security reports that the Abcbot botnet is linked to Xanthe, a Monero cryptojacking campaign first reported by Cisco Talos in late 2020. The report believes one threat actor runs both and has shifted from cryptomining toward botnet activity such as DDoS. Its evidence includes shared infrastructure, reused strings, similar shell script functions and common persistence and propagation methods. The report says the style-based links alone would be tenuous.
